probes.title: Push the locally built image and keep its digest
steps: tofu apply -target=google_artifact_registry_repository.images (after a saved plan)
docker tag the Q05 image (built once) and push it to us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/<project>/qrwtya-images/app; record the registry digest
Set var.image to the digest; every service, the worker pool and the job use that one reference
expected: The pushed image's config is the local image's (same layers, user node)
Every Cloud Run resource reports the same image digest
teardown: gcloud artifacts docker images delete <image>@<digest> --delete-tags

tofu plan -out=q12a.plan with terraform.tfvars; review that every name starts with qrwtya- except click-events, click-events--analytics-worker and click-events--analytics-worker.failed (AG-05)
tofu apply q12a.plan (without the Cloud Run resources first: -target the stores, Pub/Sub, secrets and IAM)
expected: Apply succeeds with exactly the planned resources
Cloud SQL has no public address; both Memorystore instances are CLUSTER_DISABLED with SERVER_AUTHENTICATION
The analytics subscription reads back ack 60 s, retry 1-10 s, dead letter after 100, retention 31 d, no expiration

probes.title: Managed Pub/Sub acknowledgement, IAM and the archive
steps: Through a temporary probe body in a staging-only revision (never the product image), publish 100 events with known messageIds and record each ACK latency
Read them back from a temporary capture subscription qrwtya-q12a-capture; send one poison message and read it from click-events--analytics-worker.failed with x-terminal-code
Wait up to 10 minutes for an Avro object under gs://qrwtya-click-archive-<project>/click-events/ carrying the messageId attribute
Call publish with another service's account: expect PERMISSION_DENIED
expected: Every publish resolves only after Pub/Sub's ACK; p50 and p99 recorded
The dead letter and the archive work with the Pub/Sub service agent's grants
Only the Redirect service may publish to click-events
teardown: gcloud pubsub subscriptions delete qrwtya-q12a-capture
Remove the probe revision; route 100 % to the product revision
